name: Staged: TARVA on the right wall, dresser facing it, bench at the foot, BESTÅ linen column by the closet
notes:
Staged pick, re-reviewed 2026-10-23 for F-63. Targeted changes, not a re-plan: the bed, nightstands, dresser and bench were right and stay; the 70" bottom wall gets the one storage piece it can take, the mirror moves onto the plan, and the rug moves off the bathroom walkway so the new column stands on the floor. 14 placed, 10 extras; every piece a suggestion in a staged layout (F-50).
bed-1 TARVA queen (floor): right wall, headboard centered, rot 90, x 94.75-177, y 35-98. F-34: 29" on the window side to the heater's face, 35" on the bathroom side (24" min, 30" preferred); F-33: bedding 29" from the heater face; heater-depth-assumed.
nightstand-1 IKEA PS 2026 pine (floor): window side of the head, x 165.25-177, y 23.25-35. F-33: 17.25" from the heater face. nightstand-2 IKEA PS 2026 pine (floor): bathroom side, x 165.25-177, y 98-109.75: slim (11.75" square), so the bathroom door (eyeballed at x 139-169) is approached at full depth across its left 26.25" and has 23.25" in front of its last 3.75" (F-30, F-31). Pine, like the TARVA bed and the PERJOHAN bench.
lamp-1, lamp-2 STORSEGEL (top): one on each nightstand. art-1 PJÄTTERYD endless tide 55x22" (top): right wall over the headboard, centered, x 176-177, y 39-94.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 7'10"x9'10" jute (rug): rot 0, x 40-158, y 19.5-113.5: under the lower 63" of the bed and the bench, 15.5" past each side and 54.75" past the foot; it stops short of the nightstands so they stand level, 13.5" off the heater face (F-33) and 3" short of the BESTÅ column.
dresser-1 STORKLINTA 6-drawer (floor): left wall facing the bed, x 0-18.9, y 30-85.1. F-32: 62.9" from its drawer fronts to the bench; F-31: 17.9" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door); anchor-required (F-21, 29.5"; anchor/unlock drawers). plant-1 FEJKA areca palm (top): on its window end.
bench-1 PERJOHAN pine (floor): across the foot of the bed, 2" off it, x 81.75-92.75, y 46.8-86.2. F-30: 62.9" to the dresser, 30.3" to the BESTÅ column.
floor-lamp-1 TÅGARP (floor): top-left corner, x 0-9, y 12-21. F-33: 6" from the heater face; heater-depth-assumed.
hamper-1 PURRPINGLA (floor): left wall by the door, x 0-17.3, y 92-100. F-31: 3" clear of the door's swing (assumed-position:door).
storage-1 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors, white/Lappviken, 23 5/8x16 1/2x76" (floor, new for F-63): bottom wall at the closet end of the 70" clear run, rot 180, x 70-93.6, y 116.5-133: linens and towels beside the closet, 4' from the bathroom door. F-31: 3" clear of the closet's 24" (x 25-67), assumed-position:closet; anchor-required (F-21: 76"; IKEA: must be securely anchored, never hung). It is the only floor piece that wall can take: the other 46" of the run is the 35" bathroom walkway beside the bed, where this 16.5" depth would leave 18.5" and even a 7 7/8"-deep BESTÅ frame 27.1" (walkway-narrow, F-30; F-34 tight). F-30: 30.3" between it and the bench, then 35" beside the bed to the bathroom.
mirror-1 NISSEDAL 25 5/8x59" (top, moved from the extras onto the plan): hung vertically on the walkway stretch of the 70" wall, rot 180, x 103.8-129.4, flat to the wall, so the 35" walkway stays clear: the full-length mirror between the closet and the bathroom.
Walkways (F-30): door to bathroom along the bottom of the room, 30.3" past the column and 35" beside the bed; the closet's 24" stays clear (F-31, assumed-position:closet).
Window wall: nothing but the curtains and a corner lamp. F-33 allows furniture 6" off the heater, but a cabinet there would box in the heater along the whole hatched wall (heater-depth-assumed), so no BESTÅ goes on it.
Extras: VALEVÅG mattress x1, DVALA queen sheet set x1, SMÅSPORRE Full/Queen insert x1, ÄNGSLILJA natural cover set x1, VILDKORN pillows x2, FJÄDRAR inner cushions x2 in VALLKRASSING gray-green covers x2, VALLKRASSING throw x1, BENGTA block-out panels x2 on the HUGAD rod x1 (about 107", centered on the window; cut the drop to end above the heater, F-33; assumed-position:window).
Not placed: the BRIMNES 3-door wardrobe ikea-90574800 (no wall takes 46" plus 24" in front); the 50 3/4" BESTÅ ikea-69429706 (rejected: the 76" one stores more on the same footprint); the STORKLINTA and HEMNES 2-drawer nightstands ikea-90559296 and ikea-80242627 (18 7/8" and 15" deep, they stood in front of the bathroom doorway; design review 2026-10-23); the black BRIMNES bed ikea-79129608 (its white twin is in b).
Why every variant keeps the headboard on the right wall: the top wall is the heater wall (F-33); on the left wall a queen plus two nightstands needs 102" and only 91" is free between the heater clearance (y 12) and the door's swing (y 103); on the 70" bottom wall the nightstands would stand in the closet's 24" and the bathroom doorway.
Total $2,030.78: placed $1,371.88 + extras $658.90; prices as of 2026-10-22 (price-stale, F-02) except the BESTÅ pieces, read 2026-10-23. Flags across the layout: assumed-position:door, assumed-position:closet, assumed-position:window, heater-depth-assumed, anchor-required (dresser-1, storage-1).
Design review 2026-10-23: the deeper nightstands covered the right 7 to 10.9" of the bathroom doorway with 14 to 15.4" in front; the slim IKEA PS 2026 pine pair keeps it open (above).
